user_message: explain this sql query for me
final_response:
```sql
SELECT name, COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;
```

This query joins customers and orders tables, groups by customer, and returns customers with more than 5 orders. It uses LEFT JOIN to include all customers, even those without orders.
